notes: Same generator and independent SeedSequence streams as reconstruction v1, new unused seeds only.
One draw per cell. Keep all three method records for failed input, without resampling.
Current guide occupation never guarantees future release.
All thresholds and the seven-start pairwise budget remain unchanged.
This is not an expansion of the formal convex experiment or evidence of demand-weighted advantage.

selection_rules: Estimate every scene with the convex offset and with disk-union at 1.3 m and 0.55 m. Record all of them.
Execute disk-union curves only. A convex hull is not called a non-convex boundary.
Take valid primary-offset curves in scene order, then a safety-floor curve when its primary curve is invalid or its convexity defect is below 0.001.
Stop at six curves. Do not drop a curve because a planner failed, and do not add a curve because a planner succeeded.
N is ceil(L / 1.94) and is fixed before the three planners run.
Execute a planner only when its independent arc-box and Euclidean check passes.

offset_notes.primary: Controller planning offset, metres beyond the closed occupied set.
offset_notes.safety_floor: crowd center distance 0.75 m minus the person radius 0.20 m. Locally this puts the curve 0.75 m from a person centre. It is not the controller offset.
offset_notes.closing: Estimator length. Body-surface gaps below 0.60 m can join. It is not a safety distance.
offset_notes.inward_1_6: The earlier prescribed-curve attachment inset. It is not used here and is not a safety law.
